results.title: On Budgets - Transom
results.content: # On Budgets. The reason for doing a budget is to avoid forgetting costs that will later rise up and bite you, the producer, in the ass. When this results in your going over budget, you’re going to be forced to eat the cost, which of course is also true if you’re financing a program yourself. There is no uniformity of budgets or even of categories of allowable expenses. Indies routinely don’t, as if the costs for those kinds of expense come from the IF Department: the “Department of Imaginary Funds.” That’s why the big guys get and stay big, and you know what – nobody tells them they can’t charge overhead, which is up to 20+ % of their production budget – in addition to the budget itself. Same thing with “contingency.” So, if you want to take all of the risk of your production on your own shoulders – “help yourself” and ignore overhead and contingencies in your budgets. So, a budget serves two purposes: it estimates what a project is going to cost and tells you how close you came, and it collects information so you don’t forget anything. Over the years, the budgets I developed for projects kept trying to remember more things. “Hey, how do you learn to make a budget?” a young producer once asked me. I got my station to buy its very first computer, an Apple II+ and, using the first spreadsheet program Visicalc, we immediately reduced the time to make a budget from days to a few hours. As budgets grew into multi-page templates, including every item we could identify, and adding “contingencies” for things that were unforeseen before production started, and “overhead” for costs that the company provided but couldn’t be itemized … the budgets became more and more realistic. What is the hourly rate that you charge for an employee in a budget? I now use a four-page budget template that is very complete, and calculates startup costs as well as two years of production costs. **STARTUP BUDGET**: Includes one-time only expenses that won’t recur every year, such as the cost of piloting, rights (registering a title), equipment, new media, furniture, office computers and machines, etc.).

results.content: # How to Create a Realistic Program Implementation Timeline Creating a realistic program implementation timeline is crucial for the success of any project, whether it’s a new product launch, a software development project, or a marketing campaign. A well-defined timeline helps to ensure that everyone involved understands the project’s scope, deadlines, and dependencies, and it provides a roadmap for keeping the project on track. In this comprehensive guide, we will walk you through the steps involved in creating a program implementation timeline that will help you to deliver your project on time and within budget. By having a clear understanding of what you are trying to achieve, you can better estimate the time and resources required to complete the project. Identifying these dependencies is crucial for creating a realistic timeline, as it ensures that tasks are scheduled in the correct order. Allocating resources to each task is essential for determining the project’s duration and cost. **Example:** A Gantt chart is a visual representation of the project timeline that shows the tasks, their durations, and their dependencies in a bar chart format. It’s important to identify potential risks that could impact the project timeline and to develop contingency plans to mitigate these risks. Once the project is underway, it’s important to monitor progress against the timeline and make adjustments as needed. Regular monitoring helps to ensure that the project stays on track and that any deviations from the timeline are addressed promptly. **Example:** You can use project management software to track progress, generate reports, and communicate with team members. **Example:** If a key team member unexpectedly leaves the project, you may need to adjust the timeline to account for the time required to find and train a replacement. **Example:** You can use email, project management software, or regular meetings to communicate with stakeholders. ### Conclusion Creating a realistic program implementation timeline is a critical step in ensuring the success of any project. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you can create a timeline that is both achievable and realistic, and that will help you to deliver your project on time and within budget.

results.content: # What is the best way to create a realistic timeline in Logistics Management? Creating a realistic timeline is one of the most important skills in logistics management. In this article, you will learn some tips and best practices on how to create a realistic timeline in logistics management, and how to avoid common pitfalls and mistakes. Creating a realistic timeline in Logistics Management begins with a precise definition of scope and objectives. In my experience with logistics management in manufacturing, I've learned that to set a good timeline, you need to really understand the whole supply chain, talk to everyone involved, think about things like weather or market changes, have extra time for surprises, and keep updating your plans. The third step in creating a realistic timeline is to identify and mitigate the risks that may affect your logistics project or process. The fourth step in creating a realistic timeline is to monitor and control your progress throughout your logistics project or process. The fifth step in creating a realistic timeline is to review and learn from your experience after your logistics project or process is completed. By reviewing and learning from your experience, you can improve your timeline creation skills, and increase your efficiency and effectiveness in logistics management. Software tools such as project management software, logistics software, or spreadsheet software can help you create, update, and visualize your timelines, as well as integrate them with other aspects of your logistics project or process, such as budget, resources, quality, or inventory. To create realistic timelines in logistics management, different software tools and templates are available. Creating a realistic timeline in logistics management entails understanding project requirements, breaking down tasks into manageable milestones while considering constraints like budget and regulations, setting achievable deadlines for each milestone based on historical data and potential contingencies, fostering clear communication among stakeholders to keep everyone informed, and continuously monitoring progress to make necessary adjustments. results.title: Timeline: Four years took A's Las Vegas ballpark from speculation to reality
results.content: # Timeline: Looming Athletics' Las Vegas ballpark groundbreaking is a moment more than 4 years in the making. The Oakland Athletics are expected to break ground on their ballpark on the Las Vegas Strip on Monday, June 23, 2025. LAS VEGAS (KTNV) — A date more than four years in the making has been set for the Athletics to break ground on their planned ballpark on the Las Vegas Strip. **WATCH | Nick Walters takes a look back at the culmination of the Athletics' Las Vegas ballpark groundbreaking:**. Timeline: Looming Athletics' Las Vegas ballpark groundbreaking is a moment more than 4 years in the making. This development marks the next step forward in what has been a lengthy process of relocating the Major League Baseball team from Oakland to Las Vegas. The timeline from speculation to reality has been marked by significant milestones and watched intently by Las Vegas locals — some excited about the prospect of another major professional sports team in their city, others skeptical. **WATCH | People on the Strip react to Athletics' Las Vegas ballpark:**. ### Oakland Athletics officially exploring re-location to Las Vegas. ### June 24, 2021 — A's confirm lengthy list of potential Las Vegas ballpark sites. ### March 17, 2022 — Amid back-and-forth over a new ballpark in Oakland, the A's narrow their search in Las Vegas. Athletics president Dave Kaval confirmed to Channel 13 that the organization had its eye on five potential ballpark locations in Las Vegas, all of which fell in the Resort Corridor. Months of speculation were put to rest when Bally's Corporation announced it had reached a deal with the Oakland Athletics to construct a ballpark on the Tropicana Las Vegas property. ### May 26, 2023 — First renderings of the proposed ballpark are released. ### Oct. 9, 2024 — The Tropicana implosion marks the end of an era on the Las Vegas Strip. ### Feb. 6, 2025 — New blueprints and construction plans paint a clearer picture of the future ballpark. New renderings of proposed A's Las Vegas ballpark released. The Athletics are expected to host a ceremonial groundbreaking to mark the official start of construction on their Las Vegas ballpark.
